title: 놓지 않을게
suno_analysis_sp: K-Ballad featuring a baritone male vocal. The arrangement centers on a grand piano playing rubato chords and arpeggios. A legato string section provides harmonic support with slow-moving pads. The tempo is approximately 68 BPM in 4/4 time. The vocal performance is intimate with breathy delivery in the lower register, transitioning to a more resonant chest voice. The production uses a long hall reverb on both the piano and vocals to create a spacious acoustic environment.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[grand piano playing rubato arpeggios]

[Verse 1]
[intimate baritone male vocals]
찌개가 끓는 소리만
부엌을 채우고 있어
숟가락을 놓으셨어 [strings enter, soft legato pads]
아무 말도 없이
눈 아래 그림자가
어둑하게 내려와
처음 본 떨림이야
저 손이 흔들리잖아
식탁의
